_note: Edit this file to update creator testimonials. Each entry needs: id, name, location, quote, tier, avgMonthlyListens.

testimonials.name: Meera Krishnaswamy
testimonials.quote: I recorded my grandmother's oral histories about the Brihadeeswarar temple in Tamil. A year later, tourists from across the world hear her voice at the site. Nothing prepared me for how moving that would feel.

testimonials.name: Dr. Rajendra Shastri
testimonials.quote: I am a Sanskrit scholar who spent forty years studying Ghat rituals. Naarad gave me a way to share that knowledge with every visitor — not just my students. My first month I earned ₹3,200.

testimonials.name: Priya Nair
testimonials.quote: As a local guide I was tired of being cut out by apps. Naarad actually pays me for my expertise. I record tours in Kannada, Tulu, and English — each version earns separately.

testimonials.name: Aashif Qureshi
testimonials.quote: My family has maintained Mughal-era caravanserais for generations. The stories I carry existed only in our family's memory. Now they reach everyone who walks the Taj corridor.

testimonials.name: Prof. Sunita Venkataraman
testimonials.quote: I teach Bharatanatyam history at university. My Naarad audio tours on the Brihadeeswarar inscriptions have been cited in two research papers by scholars who first heard them on-site.
